title: pasania leucocarpa
intro: Pasania leucocarpa, commonly known as Indian beech, is a species of evergreen tree in the family Meliaceae. The health benefits of Pasania leucocarpa include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve antioxidant status, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, digestive issues, and skin conditions, with its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids exhibiting anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of Pasania leucocarpa.
